name: zxyssh
description: Drive saved SSH sites through the zxySSH MCP service, with credentials held on the host.

interface.longDescription: Use the native zxySSH CLI for persistent SSH sessions, remote commands, SFTP transfers, remote file edits, and configuration imports without requiring the desktop UI.
defaultPrompt: Connect to a saved server and inspect its service status.
Synchronize a local build directory to a saved server.
